correctness.rationale: The operator equality sum_{r=0}^{p-1}S^r=(S-I)^{p-1} over F_p, with (S-I)^{p^a}=0, decomposes the spatial module into one long and p-2 short T-cyclic modules. On each memory-layer module the companion identity gives nilpotence and direct kernel equations give nullity exactly one; the corresponding nilpotent block therefore has its full module dimension. All ranks and exact extinction-state counts follow by Jordan rank arithmetic. An exact modular elimination checker independently constructed and verified every power for 17 finite prime/ring/memory triples (not offered as proof for all).

originality.rationale: The complete 2026 motivating article states an extinction-time upper bound, not a sharp Jordan partition or full rank/first-extinction distribution. Examined excerpts of older one-step linear cellular-automaton work do not contain the stated k-layer decomposition, and targeted searches of public research records located no directly equivalent assertion. value.rationale: This natural entire family is motivated by Endo’s finite-time extinction construction. Its bound does not determine how information is lost, or how many initial states disappear at a given step. The new complete Jordan law establishes a nontrivial p-dependent collapse transition, the least global extinction time and all first-extinction multiplicities, including the universal final-step fraction 1-1/p. The object and invariant are natural and arise prior to experimentation, not from an arbitrary small slice.
